outcome.technical: commit-task-work.py is the one commit verb. Task commit: `_scoped_commit.index_to_carry` asks `_invariants.index_needs(HEAD index, working index, working shard, phase)` - the fileIndex rows the shard declares, bug links it completes, its stub - and `with_index` stores HEAD's index plus exactly those as a blob (`_scoped_commit.write_blob`/`stage_blobs`, committed through `commit_from_index` via a new `blobs` argument to `stage_and_commit`/`commit_with_rows`), so an unrelated index edit stays in the working tree; a needed row the working index also lacks is refused naming `audit-task.py reindex` (`unheld_rows_refusal`). The old refusal naming commit-manifest-index.py, the HEAD-held-task filter and the whole-index bug-link path are gone. State commit: `<manifest> <phaseId> --state` (`state_targets`, `state_index`, `commit_state`, `main_state`) stages the phase file, journal, evidence and the index, never a task's files; carries the whole working index when nothing in it is ahead of the shards as the commit leaves them (own shard counts as committed) and no committed row is dropped (`committed_shards`/`ahead_of_shards`/`rows_dropped`, moved from the index verb), else only what its shard needs plus a degraded line naming what was left; takes the index lock (`--takeover`, exit 3/4); subject `chore(audit-state): phase <id> - ...` from `COMMIT_TYPE`/`COMMIT_SCOPE` (renamed so `_deps.commit_spelling_drift` derives the writer); row `audit.state.committed` now carries the session id like the task row. `_invariants`: `index_rows_owed` moved there, `index_needs` added, `commit_scope` accepts an index only when it equals parent plus what the committed shard needs (`_commit_carries_needs`), `audit_state_scope` allows the index, index-scope reader kept for history with its writer comment updated. Deleted commit-manifest-index.py, commit-audit-state.py and their two suites; their state-commit behaviour ported into test_commit_task_work.py stages st-block, ss-block, si-block, tr-block (cas1-cas36, cas40, cas50-53, cas61/62, st-ix1-10) plus the new ov-block; the commitlint transcription moved in from the deleted suite.
